ai_summary: Accuracy Shipping Limited has announced its 18th Annual General Meeting (AGM) for September 30, 2026, to be held virtually, and has informed shareholders, particularly those without registered email addresses, on how to access the Annual Report for FY 2025-26 online. A material impact is the company's strong emphasis on shareholders, especially those holding physical securities, updating their KYC details as mandated by SEBI; non-compliance will restrict all future payments (e.g., dividends) to electronic mode only, a mandate effective since April 1, 2024. The persistent nature of this reminder, two years post-mandate, suggests a potential ongoing challenge with shareholder KYC compliance, posing administrative hurdles and possible payment disruptions for affected individuals.
